findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_outages, submit_field_report, add_report_followup · Private data: get_tool, is_dangerous, submit_field_report, add_report_followup · Public sink: submit_field_report, add_report_followup, suggest_improvement.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_outages, submit_field_report, add_report_followup · Private data: get_tool, is_dangerous, submit_field_report, add_report_followup · Public sink: submit_field_report, add_report_followup, suggest_improvement

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
